title: Art. 35 — Montreal Convention 1999, Chapter III - Liability of the Carrier and Extent of Compensation for Damage, Article 35 — Limitation of Actions
theme: Liability of the Carrier and Extent of Compensation for Damage
content: 1. The right to damages shall be extinguished if an action is not brought within a period of two years, reckoned from the date of arrival at the destination, or from the date on which the aircraft ought to have arrived, or from the date on which the carriage stopped. 2. The method of calculating that period shall be determined by the law of the court seised of the case.
